page.title: Share Documents
page.description: Accelerate your deal flow by mastering frictionless file distribution. Learn how to securely share critical transaction files, contracts, and marketing materials directly from your Smart CRM to clients and co-broking agents without ever leaving the infrastructure.
page.body:
Share Documents: Frictionless File Distribution

-coming soon-

High-level real estate transactions are highly collaborative, requiring the constant and secure exchange of sensitive information. Relying on external email providers and scattered, downloaded attachments slows down your deal flow and creates critical security vulnerabilities.

The PropertyList infrastructure solves this by allowing you to securely share your uploaded documents with external parties directly from your digital headquarters.

By keeping your file distribution centralised within the Smart CRM, you maintain total control over your paperwork while ensuring your clients and collaborating partners receive the information they need instantly.

The Strategic Advantage of Centralised Sharing

Utilising the built-in Share Documents feature provides several key operational advantages for your agency:

  • Collaborative Co-Broking: Instantly share detailed architectural floor plans, energy certificates, or unbranded property brochures with co-broking agents operating on the active MLS grid.
  • Direct Client Communication: Securely send vital transaction paperwork, reservation contracts, or financial breakdowns directly to a buyer or seller linked within your CRM.
  • Professional Network Integration: Distribute required legal documents directly to your linked professional contacts, such as lawyers or notaries, ensuring the legal team can advance the transaction without delay.

Step-by-Step: How to Share a Document

To securely distribute a file from your infrastructure, follow this streamlined workflow:

  1. Step 1: Access Your Document Vault
  1. · Log in to your dashboard and navigate to the main Documents section, or open a specific contact/property profile where the desired document is already linked.
  1. Step 2: Locate the Specific File
  1. · Identify the exact document you wish to distribute (e.g., a signed contract, an ID file, or a property brochure).
  1. Step 3: Initiate the Share Protocol
  1. · Click the dedicated Share icon associated with that specific document.
  1. Step 4: Designate the Recipient
  1. · Select the destination for the file. You can effortlessly share the document directly with an existing client saved in your Smart CRM, or generate a secure transmission to a collaborating professional.
  1. Step 5: Distribute and Log
  1. · Confirm the share action. The system will securely distribute the file and, if sent to a tracked contact, automatically log the interaction within their activity history timeline so your team maintains total oversight of the negotiation process.
